Tumet started out his day well. He awoke in his chambers fairly refreshed too the smell of baked bread, a serving girls naked legs draped over his torso and the sound of soft singing down the hall. The chamber was warm and he was able to shove the girl of him and stroll about the room without clothes thanks to the warmth. He walked over a dirt floor but he didn't mind, preferred it even. The room was one of many that were dug out of a dirt cave. Once maybe it was used for mining or storage but now held his clan of thieves rapers and bandits, all his. The serving girl and the singer were his too. Taken from some cheap village. Some spear wielding, would be hero stood between threats and the village but unfortunately for him, Tumet was the threat. The girl, a slender thing with the dark hair of an Istarian he guessed, stared at him from the bed, fearful. He gave her a grimace and she cowered. "I'll be back girly. Fear me then." He said, laughing roughly. He wondered what she feared most about him. His face? With its missing teeth, crowd feet and savages hair, braided and cut. Not his hair he guessed. Tumet wasn't a comely youth or an attractive man but his hair was always his winning point. Red with brown streaks along the top. 'Maybe he's never seen a man with real muscles. The hero pup didn't' he thought. He left the girl and his warm chambers to find the bread he could smell. Beyond his room was a small hallway, separated by cloth sheets for doors. The other chamber was divided in two, one full of cots and straw piles (which were regularly fought over) and a table area, full of crates too sit on and places for a fire. He found most of his men gone already, raiding most like. Six or so stayed to guard. Three were all crowded around a bakers son they took back with them. He was working over three large loafs. They smelled fine but Tumet could see the loafs burning on one side. 'Should have taken the father instead.' One of his men napped in the big cot, another sharpened an old rust dagger. All the good weapons were out with the good men he figured. He wished they could toss the rusty crap, but men were in more supply then weapons. The singer stood behind the last of his men. Theo. loyal as a dog, but as mad as a rabid one. Theo sang along with the singer. When Tumet entered his men gave him a quick glance but the singer flinched at his entrance. His voice quivered too and Theo lashed him across the thigh. "Mistakes are like still-born's mate. Too many and you stop bothering with the cunt. Sing." Theo had switched his happy singing voice for a sterner one. The boy sang 'tears of war' for a few verses before Theo changed his mind. "None of that sappy shit." He said, whacking the boy again. "Sing 'buzzards dance." "I don't know that one sir." He pleaded. "Fine. I like teaching it anyways. Ill do the verses, and when I point, you sing, 'aye there, stop the cheer. The buzzards are gone, the battle is done, lets find them bastards and give em a ear." "Ear?" The singer questioned. "Ear. As in ear a corn." Theo said patronizingly. Theo was well past forty but the singer was no older than thirteen. 'Hes not heard it.' Tumet surmised. "Theo. he's not heard the battle of bloody willow. He's got no clue why it's 'ear'." "That true lad." Theo asked and the singer nodded. "Haha. Well, back when Ferb wasn't the only hero everyone knew there was Erny, who went about-" "Back. There back!" Called from the outside. A slender satyr woman rushed in. Selly, he knew was on guard and it was her who rushed in. "Their back from raid. Clear the table." She ordered. The singer moved out the way and Theo and the others looked at Tumet. Asking. "You heard her you fools. Move the fucking table." He ordered. In came the rest of his sorry lot. Most, were men, some Istarians and ahead of the group was a pair of satyr slaves, carrying a crate. Twenty men piles in behind them and they all sat down before the table. The satyrs sat the heavy crate down. Tumet second in command, a tall dark skinned man named Rickard, pulled a man from his seat. He sat down in his place. "What did we get Rickard." Demanded Tumet. "A chest of junk. Good junk. And a fool." "Fool?" From outside limped Yury. An old lad from the town who had asked too join up. Tumet hadn't approved at the time and here was why. The mans leg was gone. "Who did it?" He asked unsympathetically. "Caravan guard. Killed Ashleigh too but was Ashleigh's fault. Too dam drunk. This one was just a coward." Tumet walked over to the man Yury. "So. Cripple and a coward." "I'll cook, i swear, I can keep watch and-" But Tumet didn't let him finish. Tumet grabbed the stump leg. It had been poorly wrapped and the wound was beginning to fester already. Yury screamed when Tumet grabbed it. He grabbed it hard and jerked it up. Yury screamed and fell over. Tumet kicked at the wound, missing a few times but even the misses hurt, striking his ribs and arms. Tumet grew tired and ended it with a step. The screams stopped when his neck gave way. "Theo. you mind dragging this outside." Tumet took Theo's spot while he dragged of the corpse. "So. Rickard. Show me this junk.
